title: CS amp, diode-connected load
description: Common-source stage with a diode-connected transistor as the load. The load's low-impedance ~1/gm sets a gain that is a ratio of transconductances, Av = gm_in/(gm_load + gds_in + gds_load), which is well-controlled across process and temperature - the classic teaching load. The load is a composed child (pick its device table to the opposite polarity; set load_sign to -1 for a signed-PMOS table). Because it is diode-connected, the load's drain-source voltage equals its own gate-source voltage: the child is biased at vgs_est_load and the diode-bias-consistent guardrail checks that estimate against the reported vgs; retune vgs_est_load until green. The output DC level sits one load vgs below the supply.

params.name: Av_target
params.note: a diode load gives a modest, well-controlled gain

params.name: cdd_est
params.note: output-node parasitic estimate (both drains + wiring); refine from extraction

params.name: gbw_margin
params.note: over-design factor on gm for parasitics and PVT

params.name: gm_id
params.note: input inversion: high = efficient/slow, low = fast/thirsty

params.name: gm_id_load
params.note: load inversion: lower gm/ID gives a higher gain (smaller load gm) but costs the output more headroom and adds noise

params.name: vgs_est_load
params.note: estimate of the diode load's |vgs| = its |vds|; retune until the diode-bias-consistent guardrail is green

params.name: load_sign
params.note: vds sign convention of the load table: +1 for an N-style axis, -1 for a signed-PMOS axis

doc.title: Diode-connected load device
doc.description: One device diode-connected (gate tied to drain), so its vds equals its vgs. Carries the stage current, exposing its transconductance (which sets the gain and the output level), its output conductance, and its gate-source drop.

params.name: vds_ld
params.note: diode connection: vds equals vgs, signed to this table's axis convention

rows.name: V_out
rows.note: output DC level: one diode drop below the supply

rows.name: Av
rows.note: input gm into the diode load conductance (~load gm) plus both output conductances

rows.name: vn_in
rows.note: the diode load's 4kTgamma*gm drain noise referred to the input by 1/gm_in
